d:
The party anthem that broke the internet! Badnam by Mankirt Aulakh feat. DJ Flow — out now on Speed Records.
With music by DJ Flow and lyrics by Singga, Badnam became one of the biggest viral Punjabi party songs — a dancefloor and wedding favourite that still gets everyone up. Directed by Sukh Sanghera. Turn it up and enjoy!
